what.text: This page follows refugees from Croatia living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 221 Croatian refugees in Germany, 1.3% of all refugees from Croatia.
Serbia and Kosovo hosts the most Croatian refugees, followed by Germany, Norway and the Netherlands.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Croatia in these years, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2007 and 2008.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 3845 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 17747, at the end of 2007, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
